question: Should OpenClaw own Twilio RCS as a bundled sibling to SMS, or should this implementation be corrected and published as a ClawHub channel plugin?
rationale: The existing channel plugin APIs appear sufficient for external distribution, while bundling creates permanent provider support obligations and requires a deliberate SMS/RCS shared-route design.

options.title: Publish through ClawHub
options.body: Correct the route and capability defects, add live proof, and distribute the channel independently through existing plugin seams.

options.title: Sponsor bundled RCS
options.body: Accept core ownership and require canonical SMS/RCS coexistence, complete capability claims, live provider proof, dependency approval, and refreshed current-main review.

recommendation.title: Publish through ClawHub
recommendation.body: Correct the route and capability defects, add live proof, and distribute the channel independently through existing plugin seams.

likelyOwner.reason: The bundled Twilio SMS channel is the direct product and runtime precedent for deciding RCS ownership and coexistence.
